## `neuro.int8Array.set`

Instance method on `Int8Array.prototype`.

> Sets a value or an array of values.

## Signatures

```ts
set(input: { int8Array: <receiver>; array: ArrayLike<number>; offset?: number; prompt?: string }): Promise<void>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Int8Array.prototype.set` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
